reset_rng_derivation.method: PURE POSITIONAL jax.random.split chain. NO fold_in anywhere (grep: 0 hits in dicode_src/src AND in all 4 evaluators). NO categorical task sampling at reset (task->slot is a fixed once-permuted assignment).
full_chain: obsv, log_state = env.reset(reset_rng, ctor)        eval:171  (wrapper splits internally)
obs, env_state = vmapped_reset(reset_rngs, params, task_ids, task_embeddings)  wrappers_cl:231
reset_env: rng, world_rng = jax.random.split(rng) multitask.py:129  -> take [1]
S4 generate_world: rng,_r = split(rng)            s4_task_code:39; WorldBuilder(_r); s=b.build(rng) s4:47
WorldBuilder: generate_full_base_world split(rng,7)+split(rng,4); build split(rng,3)->state_rng,potion_rng; potion_mapping=permutation(potion_rng,arange(6))  world_builder:785,793,1186,1254
reset_rng_derivation.then_inner: reset_env splits once more (multitask:129); generate_world splits again (s4:39); WorldBuilder splits multiple times
reset_rng_derivation.consequence: a single world's key is NOT independently derivable from (seed, world_index); it depends on the WHOLE 256-way batch and ordering. The materializer MUST reproduce the entire batch (call env.reset(reset_rng) once and index [i]); feeding a pre-split single key back into env.reset would split it AGAIN and yield WRONG worlds.

how_evaluation_seed_enters_rng: PRNGKey(EVAL_SEED=42) at eval:169 is the ROOT of the world-generation split chain. evaluation_seed GENUINELY enters the world-generation RNG (not merely action sampling). Changing the numeric seed changes PRNGKey -> the entire split tree -> every world. (The action stream uses a separate rng split inside the scan, eval:134/146, also seeded from EVAL_SEED.)
how_world_index_enters_rng: POSITIONALLY: world_index selects reset_rngs[i] = split(_rng, 256)[i] (wrappers_cl:229). It is NOT fold_in(key, world_index) and NOT (seed_base + world_index).

world_identity_schema.world_identity_definition: the COMPLETE EnvState pytree at reset time (timestep=0, before any _craftax_step), per world index, as produced by the canonical reset chain
world_identity_schema.serialization_decision: SERIALIZE ALL 53 EnvState fields of the initial snapshot (the canonical serializer recurses the dataclass via __dataclass_fields__; arrays bind dtype+shape+C-order bytes). This guarantees NO result-affecting initial field is silently dropped, and makes the per-world hash bit-equal to the evaluator's log_state.env_state[i].
world_identity_schema.why_not_only_immutable_fields: only 6 fields are strictly immutable, but the INITIAL VALUES of the runtime-mutated fields (map terrain, item_map incl. removed floor-2 up-ladder, starting inventory, monsters_killed[2]=8, mob placements, pre-populated achievements, player_position/level) ARE the world's identity. Dropping them would discard result-affecting initial state (forbidden).
